title: Consulting Using AI: 10 use cases with copy-paste prompts
instagram:
Consultants who use AI well are pulling ahead. 🤖

❌ Hours lost on first drafts and desk research
✅ Prompts that do the first pass and show their sources

Here are 10 consulting jobs, each with a copy-paste prompt:

1️⃣ Rapid data analysis
Trends, outliers and the next questions, with the math shown.

2️⃣ Market research
A sourced market snapshot, every figure dated.

3️⃣ Strategy frameworks
SWOT, PESTEL or Five Forces built for one client.

4️⃣ Competitive intelligence
Competitor tables with a link in every cell.

5️⃣ Financial modeling
Base, best and worst case from your own inputs.

6️⃣ Instant presentations
Findings into a slide storyline, answer first.

7️⃣ Risk assessment
A scored risk register with early warning signs.

8️⃣ Performance tracking
A weekly KPI read-out with owners and actions.

9️⃣ Scenario planning
4 futures, the signals to watch, no-regret moves.

🔟 Collaboration readiness
A 6-week AI learning path for the client team.

The bottom line:
Every prompt asks for sources and assumptions. No invented numbers.
